base_rate_note: Pershing Square historically initiates 1-4 new positions annually; while 2026 was unusually active due to new vehicle capital raises, the current environment emphasizes deployment into library compounders on dislocation rather than aggressive expansion [L415, L416].

candidates.thesis_paragraph: Autodesk is a dominant software franchise with high switching costs and a capital-light business model that fits perfectly within our library of quality compounders [L514]. The market's fear regarding AI-driven disintermediation is misplaced; the company's established design workflows create deep defensive moats that our analysis suggests will be reinforced, not replaced, by AI integration [L514]. At current levels, the valuation dislocation offers an attractive opportunity to initiate a position in a simple, predictable business with high free-cash-flow conversion [L104, L514].
candidates.trigger: A 21.2% drawdown driven by market concerns over AI disruption of design workflows [L505, L506].
candidates.what_would_confirm: Form 13F for 31-Dec holdings (filed 16 Feb 2027) or a Q4 portfolio update [L423].

candidates.thesis_paragraph: Copart represents a classic network-effect business with dominant share in the salvage auction market [L531]. While recent integration costs and fluctuations in salvage volumes have spooked investors, the structural economics of the business remain intact and highly FCF-generative [L104, L531]. We view this drawdown as temporary and unwarranted, allowing us to build a meaningful stake at an entry multiple that is compelling relative to its historical performance [L120, L531].
candidates.trigger: 35.9% drawdown attributed to salvage-unit growth concerns and integration costs [L522, L523].

candidates.thesis_paragraph: Having previously owned Alphabet, we understand the business deeply and its durable advantages in the digital advertising and search ecosystem [L674]. Recent market volatility stemming from AI-related search and capex anxiety has created an opportunity to re-enter this dominant, capital-light compounder [L104, L674]. We believe the long-term earnings trajectory is robust, and the current multiple fails to reflect the intrinsic value of its core franchises [L121, L674].
candidates.trigger: 21.6% drawdown due to AI search and capex concerns [L665, L666].

candidates.thesis_paragraph: Booking Holdings operates a highly capital-light demand aggregation model that remains a leader in the travel industry [L497]. We disagree with the market's current narrative that AI agents will successfully disintermediate its travel moat [L497]. The distribution economics in the travel sector are robust, and we believe the current pricing gap provides a substantial margin of safety for a business that continues to execute well [L184, L497].
candidates.trigger: 29.4% drawdown caused by AI agent disintermediation fears [L488, L489].

candidates.thesis_paragraph: Zoetis remains a high-quality leader in animal health and is a known quantity within our library [L603]. The recent valuation dislocation is a response to clinic demand headwinds which we judge to be temporary rather than structural [L603]. We are comfortable re-underwriting the firm's normalized earnings power and believe the current price offers an asymmetric risk-reward profile for a long-term compounder [L184, L603].
candidates.trigger: 45.2% drawdown from weak clinic demand [L594, L595].

existing_position_changes.why: The 18.5% drawdown driven by macro volatility and AI fears allows us to add to a high-quality data and ratings business we know intimately [L541, L549].
We continue to view the market's AI capital expenditure anxiety as a temporary mispricing of a dominant, capital-light advertising franchise [L630, L639].

scoring_plan: Aman should score this in early 2027 by evaluating whether the logic of 'dislocation-driven quality purchases' was maintained. Decision fidelity should be measured by comparing observed additions to the 'library' criteria (e.g., did they buy a non-Pershing company with <15% drawdown, or one that was levered/acquisition-heavy?). Unobserved positions as of the final pack date are not 'wrong,' but the reasoning for why a trade was NOT taken (e.g., waiting for deeper price drops in a specific sector) should be held against the eventual disclosures.

single_most_likely_next_trade.one_paragraph_why: Given Pershing Square's deep intimacy with S&P Global and our confidence in its ratings and index franchises, the current 18.5% drawdown provides an ideal opportunity for an add-on trade [L539, L549]. We view the recent price pressure as reflecting broader AI/macro sentiment rather than an impairment of intrinsic value, making this the most efficient path for deploying capital during periods of index-wide volatility [L540, L549].

uncited_claims: The 2026/2027 market outlook remains influenced by political stability and resolution of conflicts.
